posts.title: Heard about a contractor who lost a lot of money over an expired license. How do you prevent this?
posts.text: Heard a story recently that I can't get out of my head. A contractor sent his crew to a job site. GC checked credentials. One guy's license had lapsed. Whole crew got sent home. Lost a lot of money in one day. Got me thinking about my own situation. How does everyone here actually track license and cert renewals for their crew? Especially when you have multiple guys with different certs expiring at different times? Spreadsheet? Calendar reminders? Something else?
